title: Quorum Configuration Changes and Liveness Margin in the Stellar Network, 2019-2026: report, scripts and proofs
description: Scripts, cached data and technical report for a longitudinal analysis of the Stellar public network from May 2019 to October 2026: 1.2 million OBSRVR Radar network scans, 159 full network snapshots, and daily availability for every top tier organization. The report documents four single operator quorum set changes that lowered the liveness margin of the whole network, the organization outages and the degradation that preceded them, and a scoring of simple availability based early warning rules (precision, recall, lead time) across all top tier organizations. See README.md for which script produces which number in the report. Version 1.1.0 adds a note with propositions and proofs on the liveness margin of a symmetric top tier under reconfiguration (partial updates, add before remove interleavings), the script that checks them, a recomputation of alternatives to Blockdaemon's quorum set change of May 2020, and single operator removals computed on the configuration of 1 October 2026.
